tasks.label: Build: Debug Mode
tasks.command: python3 build.py -e only_down_deps=true && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && make -C build -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Clean: All Workspace
tasks.command: find build -depth -type d -name CMakeFiles -exec rm -rf {} + ; find build -depth -type d -name Testing -exec rm -rf {} + ; find build -depth -type d -name CTestTestfile.cmake -exec rm -rf {} + ; find build -depth -type f -name cmake_install.cmake -delete ; find build -depth -type d -name analysis-prefix -exec rm -rf {} + ; rm -rf prefix output artifacts test/build_llt test/output test/opensource opensource platform
